title: Order Uplift Schedule for Weight-Overage Refunds, Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
# Order uplift schedule for weight-overage refunds

Schedule for Cartwise Grocery Orders. The weight-overage refund on a line sold by weight is raised by an order uplift before the refund is rounded to the cent: the overage weight multiplied by its price is multiplied by one plus the uplift percentage divided by 100, and the product is rounded to the cent once.

## Schedule

| The order already carries an item refund for a missing, damaged, wrong item or quality issue | Item subtotal of the order | Uplift |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Yes | at least 125.00 | 10 percent |
| Yes | below 125.00 | 5 percent |
| No | any | not raised |

## Terms of the schedule

- **Item refund for a missing, damaged, wrong item or quality issue** — an item refund entry already standing on the order whose refund reason is missing, damaged, wrong item or quality. One such entry is enough.
- **Item subtotal** — the sum of the amounts billed on the order's item lines.
- The threshold of 125.00 is met at exactly 125.00: an item subtotal of 125.00 takes 10 percent, one of 124.99 takes 5 percent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

An overage weight of 0.40 pound priced at 4.00 per pound comes to 1.60 before rounding.

| Order standing | Uplift | Refund after rounding |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Carries a missing refund, item subtotal 140.00 | 10 percent | 1.76 |
| Carries a quality refund, item subtotal 90.00 | 5 percent | 1.68 |
| Carries no such refund, item subtotal 140.00 | not raised | 1.60 |
